title: JKO-GRPO: Augmenting GRPO with Wasserstein Proximal Steps for Flow-Matching VLAs
abstract: arXiv:2611.29646v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Flow-based vision-language-action (VLA) models such as $\pi_0,\pi_{0.5}$ generate continuous action chunks by flow matching, and online reinforcement learning (RL) can improve them beyond supervised fine-tuning. Existing methods, such as Flow-GRPO and $\pi_{\mathrm{RL}}$, optimize likelihood ratios of stochastic denoising transitions, which reweight the sampled actions by their advantages but do not use the distances between them. We propose JKO-GRPO, which augments Flow-GRPO with Wasserstein proximal steps, with two contributions: (1) At each state, we treat the group of sampled actions as an empirical distribution and formulate policy improvement as a Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto (JKO) step. We use a soft discrete $c$-transform to construct transport targets from group-relative advantages and combine shared-noise regression of the deterministic flow sampler onto these targets and combined with the clipped Flow-GRPO objective without Kull

translated_title: JKO-GRPO：用Wasserstein近端步骤增强面向流匹配视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型的GRPO
translated_abstract: 基于流的视觉-语言-动作（VLA）模型（如π₀、π₀.₅）通过流匹配生成连续动作块，而在线强化学习（RL）可以使其性能超越监督微调。现有方法（如Flow-GRPO和π_RL）优化随机去噪转移的似然比，仅通过优势值对采样动作进行重新加权，但并未利用动作之间的距离信息。我们提出JKO-GRPO，通过Wasserstein近端步骤来增强Flow-GRPO，主要包含两项贡献：（1）在每个状态处，我们将采样的动作组视为一个经验分布，并将策略改进表述为Jordan-Kinderlehrer-Otto（JKO）步骤。我们使用软离散c-变换从组相对优势构建传输目标，并将确定性流采样器对这些目标的共享噪声回归与（不带KL散度的）截断Flow-GRPO目标相结合……
tldr: 该论文提出JKO-GRPO，将采样动作组视为经验分布、以JKO/Wasserstein近端步骤的形式来表述策略改进，通过软离散c-变换将组相对优势转化为传输目标，从而增强Flow-GRPO对流匹配VLA模型的在线强化学习优化。
en_tdlr: JKO-GRPO augments Flow-GRPO by treating sampled action groups as empirical distributions and formulating policy improvement as JKO/Wasserstein proximal steps, using a soft discrete c-transform to convert group-relative advantages into transport targets for improving flow-matching VLAs.
